content.comment_body: Hello, I am working with a [product_name] PLC ([article_no]). This model does not support (0-10)V DC analog inputs. I need to add analog input functionality. Which analog input module is compatible with this PLC? Will the ([article_no]) analog input module work with it? Thank you.
Yes, the [product_name] analog module ([article_no]) provides two channels and can process both 0-10V or 0/4-20mA signals. [article_no]
Does this analog input module work with the [product_name] PLC using 230V AC? Should I supply separate 24V DC power for the analog input module, or can I provide 230V AC?
The analog module requires either 12 VDC or 24 VDC as its power supply. Note: After installing the [product_name] analog input module, adding further 230V AC expansion modules is not possible.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum contributors are addressing limitations of a specific [product_name] PLC that lacks built-in analog input support. The thread centers on identifying a compatible analog input module, its connectivity, and correct power supply requirements. There is evident confusion about power supply type and module expansion options, pointing to gaps in available documentation and clarity regarding module integration.
